table_s1_caption: Supplementary Table S1. Cross-validation and independent test-set performance of conventional machine-learning and deep-neural-network nephrotoxicity prediction models.
table_s1_note: Model selection used mean ROC-AUC across 10 development folds. CV variability is the SD across folds. Test AUC 95% CI used 2,000 stratified bootstrap replicates. Threshold metrics used p >= 0.5.
table_s2_caption: Supplementary Table S2. Hyperparameter search spaces and optimized configurations of conventional machine-learning and deep-neural-network nephrotoxicity prediction models.
table_s2_note: The search used three prespecified candidate configurations per model, rather than a Cartesian-product grid. Candidate IDs in code are zero-based.
